name.ja: BB戦士 302関羽(カンウ)ガンダム

ja: 新シリーズ「BB戦士三国伝 風雲豪傑編」より鬼髯の大武勇“関羽ガンダム”が登場 兜の鬼面は差し替えによりマスク形態を再現 鎧の着脱により軽装形態を再現 握り拳以外に、表情の付いた平手（左手）が付属
en: From the new series "BB Senshi Sangokuden Fuun Goketsu Hen " comes the bearded great hero " Guan Yu Gundam". The demon mask on the helmet reproduces the mask form by replacing it. The light armor form can be reproduced by attaching and removing the armor. In addition to the clenched fist, a flat hand (left hand) with an expression is included.
